# Check white pixel position and any changes
def find_pixel(frame, color):
    lines = frame.ascii.split('\n')
    positions = []
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        for j, ch in enumerate(line):
            if ch == color:
                positions.append((i, j))
    return positions

before = last_transition.before_frame
after = last_transition.after_frame

white_before = find_pixel(before, 'W')
white_after = find_pixel(after, 'W')
print(f"White: {white_before} -> {white_after}")

# Check blue dots - did any disappear?
blue_before = find_pixel(before, 'b')
blue_after = find_pixel(after, 'b')
print(f"Blue pixels before: {len(blue_before)}, after: {len(blue_after)}")

# Check yellow dots
yellow_before = find_pixel(before, 'Y')
yellow_after = find_pixel(after, 'Y')
print(f"Yellow pixels before: {len(yellow_before)}, after: {len(yellow_after)}")

# Check charcoal boxes
seg_before = before.segmentation
seg_after = after.segmentation
print(f"Nodes before: {len(seg_before['nodes'])}, after: {len(seg_after['nodes'])}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
